# `aitbc plugin load`

Load and display a brand plugin by name.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc plugin load [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Wallet name. |
| `--plugins-dir` | text | — | no | Directory containing .py brand plugins |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc plugin load --name <name>
```
